# WasteMates

> WasteMates is an affordable rubbish removal business based in Mooroolbark, Victoria, Australia, serving Melbourne's outer east. Prices start from $40 per item, with a fixed, upfront price confirmed on site before any work starts.

**Key facts**

- Business: WasteMates, rubbish removal
- Base: Cambridge Road, Mooroolbark VIC 3138, Australia
- Service area: Mooroolbark, Chirnside Park, Lilydale, Kilsyth, Kilsyth South, Montrose, Mount Evelyn, Croydon, Croydon North, Croydon Hills, Wonga Park, Coldstream, Ringwood East, Heathmont, Bayswater North and the surrounding Yarra Ranges, Maroondah and Knox suburbs, plus greater Melbourne for bigger jobs
- Hours: 7 days a week, 7am to 8pm
- Phone: 0494 013 254
- Email: info@wastemates.com.au
- Website: https://wastemates.com.au/

**Price list (current as of October 2026, Australian dollars, no GST added)**

Loose rubbish is priced per cubic metre. Listed items are priced per item, separately from cubic-metre loads. The final price can also depend on weight and access and is confirmed on site before work starts.

Rubbish by the load, per cubic metre:

- Green waste: $75
- General waste: $100
- Heavy waste (bricks, concrete, soil, heavy logs): $150

Mattresses and couches, per item:

- Mattress pickup (any size, left out the front): $70
- Mattress removal (any size, carried out from inside): $80
- 1-seat couch: $100
- 2-seat couch: $125
- 3-seat couch: $150
- Fold-out sofa beds are not covered by the couch prices and are quoted separately

Fridges and white goods, per item:

- Fridge or freezer (full height): $100
- Double-door fridge (full height): $125
- Square white goods (washing machine, dryer, oven, mini fridge or freezer): $75

Tyres, per tyre:

- Tyre, no rim: $40
- Tyre on rim: $50

**What WasteMates does not take**

Asbestos, hazardous chemicals, and medical or biohazard waste.
